name: @substrate-system/dom
description: Helpers for working with the DOM

scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:node && esbuild ./test/index.ts --bundle | tapout -t 15000
scripts.test:node: esbuild test/node/fixture.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/node-fixture.js && esbuild test/node/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/node-exit.js && node test/node-exit.js
scripts.build: mkdir -p ./dist && rm -rf ./dist/* && npm run build-cjs && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.version: npm run toc && auto-changelog -p --template keepachangelog --breaking-pattern 'BREAKING CHANGE:' && git add CHANGELOG.md README.md

author: nichoth <nichoth@gmail.com> (https://nichoth.com)
